title: Fairness-Aware Classification with Synthetic Tabular Data

contributions.purpose: 可控偏见注入的公平性测试平台
contributions.mechanism: 合成表格数据生成器,logit 中减 γ·1[a=0] 注入偏见(γ=0.3)
contributions.evaluation: 1,000 样本,3 连续特征+二元受保护属性,seed=42
contributions.source_quote: A synthetic dataset generation framework with controllable bias injection for systematic fairness evaluation

contributions.mechanism: 公平感知逻辑回归(重加权)+对抗去偏(minimax)
contributions.source_quote: Implementation and comparison of lightweight fairness mitigation strategies including fairness-aware logistic regression and adversarial debiasing

contributions.evaluation: 最优对抗 λ=0.01 使 DP 0.146→0.005,精度仅降 4.4pp(相对最优基线 RF 0.852)
contributions.source_quote: The Adversarial Network with λ= 0.01 achieves the best fairness-accuracy trade-off, reducing demographic parity violation to just 0.5% while maintaining 80.8% accuracy—only 4.4 percentage points below the best baseline.

notes: 数据红旗:循环自证——偏见由自己用 γ=0.3 经 Eq.4 合成注入,再证明自家方法能消除,数据完全合成(仅 1,000 样本)、无任何真实数据验证(自认 limitation)。Claude AI 为主作者('Claude AI served as the primary author, designing... implementing all code... writing the paper')。权衡带数字(-4.4pp/DP 0.005)。seed=42 确定性。decision=reject。自声明 5 条 contributions 归并为 3 条。
